notes: Ore you are keeping no longer counts toward what you have left to sell - it gets its own KEEPING line, in SCU rather than aUEC. Tap the estimate to see where the ore actually is, broken down by terminal. An order can finally say Part sold - kept. A multi-ore run now sends ONE ready-to-collect alert instead of one per ore, and an order finishing while you are on another tab actually reaches you - the bell could not notice time passing before. Selling a load asks one figure per line and splits each job's exact share; the confusing That's all of it tickbox is gone.
